'''jedimaster Agents Doing The Jawa Jive''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Strategy:''' Agents In The Court
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Court jedimaster LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]
